/* Forwards one bound raw physics-step delegate without altering its argument order.
   
   Algorithm:
   Load method pointer from delegate+0x10 and owner from+0x08, replace RCX with the owner, and call
   the method. RDX (FPhysScene), R8D (scene type), and XMM3 (delta seconds) remain unchanged. Return
   true in AL after the method returns.
   
   This is virtual+0x68 of vtable143510A68. Registration1421377C0 allocates three16-byte units and
   stores a nonzero handle at+0x20. The callable itself performs no owner liveness or count
   validation. Callers must preserve native dispatch and separately establish the registered owner's
   lifetime/state before classifying a route as inert.
   
   Parameters: pDelegate is raw callable storage; pPhysicsScene, dwSceneType and flDeltaSeconds are
   forwarded unchanged. Returns:
   bool true. Limited signature/behavior annotation; no complete delegate type recovery is claimed.
    */

bool InvokePhysicsStepRawDelegate
               (void *pDelegate,void *pPhysicsScene,uint dwSceneType,float flDeltaSeconds)

{
  (**(code **)((longlong)pDelegate + 0x10))(*(undefined8 *)((longlong)pDelegate + 8));
  return true;
}
